provisions: Amends the Charter to prohibit the approval, construction, expansion, or operation of new data centers within the City; prohibits the City from issuing development approvals or permits authorizing such facilities; defines “data center”; and requires voter approval before the Charter prohibition may be amended or repealed.
title: PROHIBITION ON NEW DATA CENTERS

provisions: Prohibits defined commercial data centers as principal or accessory uses in all zoning districts within Plan Commission jurisdiction, including PUDs. Includes hyperscale facilities, crypto-mining and server farms, while retaining specified telecom/public-broadband and bounded accessory-IT exclusions. Adds infrastructure-circumvention restrictions for prohibited facilities while preserving standalone BESS rules for permitted uses.
title: Starke County Ordinance No. 2026-34: commercial data-center prohibition

provisions: Prohibits permitting, establishing or operating defined data centers at property in any city zone. The definition excludes the specified wireless communication facility and communication equipment building. Accessory server rooms, data processing equipment and information technology facilities are exempt only when incidental, subordinate and specifically related to a permitted principal use; unrelated server-room operation is prohibited. Lawfully established pre-effective uses are subject to Chapter 17.78.
title: Coachella Ordinance No. 1231, Chapter 17.92
